summary: Known issues in dellemc.openmanage for Ansible 10.7.0: idrac_diagnostics can't export via a SOCKS proxy to HTTP/HTTPS shares, idrac_firmware can't update from authenticated HTTP/HTTPS/FTP shares on iDRAC8, and ome_smart_fabric_uplink modifies an existing uplink when the same name is reused.
questions: Can idrac_firmware update firmware from an authenticated share on iDRAC8?
Why did creating a fabric uplink overwrite my existing one?
Does idrac_diagnostics work through a SOCKS proxy?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage known issues (10.7.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `idrac_diagnostics`: can't export to HTTP/HTTPS shares through a SOCKS proxy.
- `idrac_firmware`: no firmware updates from HTTP, HTTPS or FTP shares with authentication on iDRAC8.
- `ome_smart_fabric_uplink`: reusing an existing uplink name modifies that uplink instead of creating a new one.
